title: Define common patterns for identifiers, provenance, versions and validity
requirements:
- Require assigning authority, type, status, period and provenance for every identifier
- Define cross-component patterns for identifiers, provenance, lifecycle status and effective periods
- Add source authority, effective period, verification status, reason for change and supersession
- Define identifier format, namespace and resolver
- Define assurance levels across foundational ID, CRVS, biometrics and local evidence, and their appropriate uses
- Cover source inventory, temporary crosswalks, canonical identifier assignment and duplicate resolution
- Define creation, correction, merger, retirement, non-reuse and historical resolution
- Apply versioning, validity and integrity requirements to all governed artefacts and registry records
